test_title: PYST 26: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 27 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

To prevent boredom and keep it away, we need to find solutions at home that will provides lasting meaning and challenge to our lives.

options.text: we need to find solutions at home that will provides
To prevent boredom and keep it away,
lasting meaning and challenge to our lives.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect usage of the verb "**provides**" after "**solutions**."
 
• The verb should be in its base form "**provide**" to match the plural noun "**solutions**."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**solutions at home that will provide**," ensuring grammatical correctness and subject-verb agreement.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"To prevent boredom and keep it away, we need to find **solutions** at home that will** provide **lasting meaning and challenge to our lives."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "To prevent boredom and keep it away," **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "lasting meaning and challenge to our lives."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "No error"** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in Option 1.
